basis: The file is the retained project-local 3DMolT5-processed 3DMolM PubChem pretraining source, not an unreviewed network payload.
Cross-instance copying was closed by a zero-difference checksum comparison.
Two fresh-process P2 identity extractions independently matched the complete file bytes and SHA-256 before and after decoding all 301655 payload records.

Both identity extractions decoded all 301655 payload records, checked CID/key and identity-required fields, observed no LMDB metadata keys, and matched the complete source hash before and after decoding.
The identity extractions did not pre-validate the census ten-field closed payload schema; the census extractor must validate that schema record by record and report closed rejects.
limitations: This decision authorizes only deterministic offline decoding of the exact locked file.
It does not recover or validate the unknown legacy motif-sequence producer.
It does not approve a P1/P2 vocabulary union, tokenizer freeze, or training admission.
